recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white photograph featuring a musician with an afro and beard, captured in a dynamic, joyful pose next to an open grand piano. The perspective is a steep, diagonal bird's-eye view, emphasizing the internal mechanical structure of the piano strings and the keyboard.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal tension between the musician on the left and the piano on the right
High-key highlights on the piano keys and strings against deep black shadows
Text placed at the extreme top corners to frame the central action
coreInvariants: Strict black and white color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The musician occupies the upper-left quadrant, while the piano dominates the lower-right and center at a 45-degree angle.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white piano keyboard running diagonally through the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal line of the keyboard from bottom-left to top-right, then circles back to the musician's expressive face and hands.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space in the upper-right and surrounding the musician's silhouette.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black for shadows and background
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for highlights on keys and clothing
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone greys for metallic piano strings
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast with minimal mid-tones.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick and thin lines
Lowercase-only styling for a modern 70s feel
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tight kerning where letters almost touch
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in two different corner locations for balance.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the tight, high-contrast 70s serif aesthetic.
Provides the necessary legibility and classic serif structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-contrast black and white photo from a high angle looking down at a 45-degree angle. On the left, a man with an afro and beard in a dark jacket and light shirt is mid-motion. On the right, the interior of a grand piano is exposed, showing strings and the keyboard. The lighting is harsh, creating deep blacks and bright whites.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add lowercase serif text in white at the top left and top right corners. Use tight tracking and a medium-weight transitional serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the piano at a sharp diagonal angle?
Is the text lowercase and placed in the top corners?
Is the contrast high enough to lose detail in the deepest shadows?

mustRedesign: Record label logos in the bottom corner
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the keyboard is a primary diagonal lead-in line.
Check that the musician's expression is visible despite the high contrast.
Verify text is lowercase and positioned at the extreme top edge.
Confirm the piano interior details (strings) are crisp.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-angle diagonal shot of a mechanical object with a human subject in high-contrast B&W, framed by corner-aligned lowercase serif typography.
